title: Benign Nonconvex Landscape for Policy Optimization: Infinite-Horizon Discounted MDPs with General State and Action Spaces
summary: We study the optimization landscape for infinite-horizon discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs) with general state and action spaces under structured stationary policy classes. A general weighted policy-iteration approach to establishing global convergence guarantees for policy gradient methods requires closure under weighted policy improvement at every policy, a property that may fail even when the policy class contains an optimal policy.
